_comment: E-6 regression-tripwire baseline (last-known-good last-main idle/peak medians, kB=KiB, per docs/BENCHMARK.md section 17 G4b run 35641694726). Updated by the update-baseline job in .github/workflows/bench.yml on every push-to-main bench-gate PASS. This is a 10%-regression TRIPWIRE only: it never raises or lowers the absolute 10 MiB idle / 40 MiB peak targets enforced separately by bench/measure.py --gate, and a regression-gate failure never overrides an absolute-target failure or PASS.
